title: Airport Luggage Allowance in Wayfare Rides Drop-Off Reviews
content:
A luggage allowance applies to airport trips in a wrong drop-off review on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**. It is decided by whether the trip carries an airport fee entry and which end of the trip was at the airport.

| Trip carries an airport fee entry | Airport end of the trip | Luggage allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | pickup | $5.00 (airport-pickup luggage allowance) |
| Yes | drop-off | $2.50 (airport-drop-off luggage allowance) |
| No | any | none |

A trip carrying an airport fee entry whose airport end was the pickup takes the airport-pickup luggage allowance of $5.00; one carrying an airport fee entry whose airport end was the drop-off takes the airport-drop-off luggage allowance of $2.50; any other trip takes none.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- A trip picked up at an airport, with an airport fee entry on the trip: $5.00.
- A trip dropped off at an airport, with an airport fee entry on the trip: $2.50.
- A trip with an airport at one end but no airport fee entry on the trip: none.
